name: print-social-white-and-yellow-were-hiring-cover-with-two-megaphones
title: White and yellow 'We're Hiring!' cover banner with two 3D megaphones and a vertical 'Open Positions' tab
whatItIs: A wide white Facebook cover with two black-and-yellow 3D megaphones, a headline 'We're HIRING! Join Our Creative & Professional Team!' mixing yellow and black weights, an outlined tagline box, and a yellow rounded panel with a vertical 'Open Positions' label beside dark role bars, plus WhatsApp and address.
whatItMeans: Bright and welcoming; yellow feels optimistic and draws attention to the roles.
techniques: Place two megaphones facing inward toward the headline.
Rotate a section label vertically beside its list.
Put roles on dark bars inside a yellow panel.

vocabulary.definition: A rotated label on a panel edge.
A bar naming one job opening.
